answer: To resist sybil attacks, each agent must post a bonded stake whose identity commitment is sealed at umber dusk and only unsealed at dawn, forcing every pseudonym to carry real locked capital across epochs. A peer quorum then verifies each registration signal against a formal proof of stake continuity, so duplicate identities collapse into one accountable lineage. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
